anomaly_def.Name: Query Plan Selection Anomaly + Transaction Lock Contention Anomaly
anomaly_def.Description:
Query Plan Selection Anomaly : The optimizer reuses or chooses a substantially sub-optimal execution plan even though the underlying statistics are adequate.
Transaction Lock Contention Anomaly : Concurrent transactions request incompatible locks on the same resources, producing long blocking chains or deadlocks.

When both root causes strike together, inefficient plans (e.g., full-table scans, unordered nested loops, or missing parallelism) hold larger lock footprints for longer durations, while the resulting lock waits postpone plan-dependent work in other sessions. Observable symptoms include: sudden plan flips followed by explosive lock-wait time, dramatic drops in throughput, erratic query runtimes where some executions finish quickly while others stall behind blockers, frequent deadlock reports after a plan change, and lock-escalation events triggered by the inflated I/O and row count of the poor plan. Performance tools show both high CPU/I/O from the bad plan and a lock table filled with long-lived blockers and victims.

Causal interaction: a sub-optimal plan inflates the amount of data touched and lengthens transaction duration, expanding the window during which locks are held. The enlarged lock scope (row → page → table) amplifies contention, which in turn prolongs queues in the lock manager. Extended wait times keep transactions open longer, preventing plan-cache turnover and fostering further reuse of the bad plan across parameter values, reinforcing poor plan selection. The feedback loop between plan inefficiency and lock contention thus deepens and perpetuates both problems, degrading overall OLTP system stability.

entry.official_description: Timeout exceeded in regular expression match.
entry.cause_analysis: The failure is typically associated with extended waiting, resource queues, unresponsive peers, or configured time limits being exceeded before the requested operation completes.
entry.solution_guidance: Check wait sources, blocking chains, network responsiveness, timeout settings, and whether resource contention is prolonging operation completion.
